newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks' gains eroded by profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks' gains eroded by profit-taking.

text.p: Stocks in Madrid closed below their highs for the day, as profit-taking and lower bond prices eroded earlier gains.
* Telefonica fell five pesetas to 2,385 on profit-taking
* ENCE gained, helped by Goldman Sachs buy recommendation, and finished up 85 pesetas at 1,915
* Repsol fell ahead of first half results, expected to show a 13 percent fall in its operating margin. It closed down 15 pesetas at 4,085.
Trading volume was reasonable at around 29 billion pesetas but concentrated on Telefonica, Santander and Argentaria.
"A lot of people are still on holiday but activity is increasing thanks above all to foreign investors," a trader said.
